categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Modifies Tor control integration files (src/torcontrol.cpp, src/torcontrol.h), which are explicitly covered under P2P.
categories.rationale: Reduces debug.log pollution by stopping default-configured nodes from logging roughly 18 warning lines per hour when Tor is not running. This addresses a regression introduced in v32 without affecting network behavior.
